local_bottleneck: Local resident director (CLG/co) or 2 of ≥3 board being SG citizens/PRs (charity); local registered office
time_to_register: 1–4 weeks (2 wks typical with agent; IRC charity status adds weeks)
deduction: No personal income tax deduction for charitable gifts — charities provide no tax benefit
foreign_donor_restriction: None notable — no FCRA-style register; foreign funding of Singapore charities freely permitted
corrections: Confirm CLG ≥1 resident director; IRC s16 charity registration needs ≥2 of ≥3 board SG citizens/PRs — prior '≥1 trustee' understates

local_bottleneck: ≥7 members to register society, ≥1 local resident officer, local registered office; CLBG needs local resident director
deduction: Registered charity gifts deductible up to 10% of chargeable income (50% of gift amount)
foreign_donor_restriction: None notable — no FCRA-style regime; foreign funding of registered societies permitted
corrections: Confirm Societies Act 1966 (Act 32); ≥7 individual members required; ≥1 local resident officer; RM100–2,000 with agent

local_bottleneck: Foreign founder must have resided in Indonesia ≥5 consecutive years; in practice local individual/PT is founder of record
deduction: Gifts to qualified charities (PAWU/PSI) deductible up to 20% of taxable income
foreign_donor_restriction: None notable — no FCRA-style regime; foreign funding of foundations permitted
corrections: Confirm 5-consecutive-years residence for foreign founder; foreigner may sit on board (pengurus) without residing; all-Indonesian founders min IDR 100M assets

local_bottleneck: Thai-national founders of record; ≥THB 500k assets (250k cash); local office; Thai-language docs; in-person notarisation
deduction: Gifts to registered charities/non-profits deductible up to 10% of taxable income
foreign_donor_restriction: None notable — no FCRA; foreign funding permitted; lèse-majesté (Art 112) risk if activities touch monarchy
corrections: Confirm foundation min assets THB 500k (250k cash); official fee only ~THB 210 — prior THB 30k–100k figure is counsel cost

local_bottleneck: Individuals cannot found a local charity; INGO rep office needs MFA/COMINGO (Decree 58), single office, foreign-only funding
time_to_register: N/A for individual; INGO rep office 3–6 months
deduction: Gifts to registered social-charity orgs deductible; personal cap 10% of taxable income
foreign_donor_restriction: INGO rep-office registration via MFA/COMINGO (Decree 58); funding must come from abroad; no local fundraising by INGOs
corrections: Confirm; INGO limited to one rep office (Hanoi, HCMC, Da Nang) and foreign-only funding under Decree 58 (2022)

local_bottleneck: ≥2/3 of directors Filipino & PH-resident; local office; SEC + BIR steps; branch of foreign NSS can't get tax exemption
deduction: Gifts to DONR-accredited NPOs deductible; individuals capped at 10% of gross income
foreign_donor_restriction: None notable — no FCRA; foreign funding unrestricted; branch offices of foreign NSS don't qualify for tax exemption
corrections: Confirm 2/3 resident-Filipino director rule (5–15 directors); trust needs Filipino trustees; branch of foreign NSS not tax-exempt

local_bottleneck: Domestic association: ≥3 Khmer-national founders; foreign NGOs: MOFA 3-yr MOU; 2025 NGO-law amendments tighten controls
time_to_register: N/A for foreign individual; 1–2 months via Cambodian nationals
deduction: Gifts to registered charitable NGOs deductible under PIT; regime modest, administration capacity limited
foreign_donor_restriction: Foreign-funded NGOs must register with MOFA (3-yr MOU); 2025 amendments add controls; periodic clampdowns on donor funding
corrections: Confirm ≥3 Khmer-national founders (LANGO 2003); foreign NGOs via MOFA 3-yr MOU; 2025 NGO-law amendments further tighten

local_bottleneck: Lao-national chair, majority-Lao founders; MFA operation permit + project MOUs; Lao-language filings
time_to_register: N/A for foreign individual; INGO permit 2–6 months
deduction: None general — PIT allows no standard charitable deduction for registered organisations
foreign_donor_restriction: INGOs need MFA operation permit (PM Decree 013/2010) and project-by-project MOU with line ministries
corrections: Confirm state-controlled model; 2023 decree on associations: resident foreigners may join as members, chair must be Lao national
